description: Free. Lists every DripMetrics metric endpoint with its id, family, HTTP method, USD price, and summary. Use describe_metric for parameter details and get_metric (or the compute_* tools for POST endpoints) to fetch values. Paid fetches use x402 with USDC on Base or USDG on Robinhood Chain; discovery is free.

family.description: Optional family filter, e.g. "Exchange metrics" or "BTC options".

name: list_metrics
title: List DripMetrics metrics
